Tuesday, December 13, 2016
Seth's white outfit is rather bright and almost blinding.
The gold paint could be a tad neater, but it looks good against the white outfit.
The "SR" belt logo is also really neat and clean, as are the wristbands.
I love this Seth Rollins headsculpt. You can almost hear Seth's cocky cackle when looking at this figure
He also only has a little bit of blonde in his hair, as that hairstyle element was in the process of being almost gone by SummerSlam 2015.
